current.text: His toe injury is reportedly healed.
Ty Jerome is the starting point guard and started both preseason games. Pippen is projected to come off the bench behind him.
He is expected to be the sixth man and competes with Jaylen Wells for minutes.
He has been working at shooting guard.
He could start next to Jerome. If Jerome gets hurt and Pippen starts, he would be a must-add in every league.
The expert says he is ranked too low. He is worth a late pick as a deep-bench stash and is the expert's late-round swing pick on Memphis.
Memphis is expected to use an 11 or 12 man rotation. Coach Tuomas Iisalo uses short stints and keeps minutes down, which limits a bench guard's minutes.
Memphis plays a 4-4-4 schedule in the fantasy playoff weeks with a March 28 end. The team has only 13 back-to-backs, possibly the fewest in the league.

durable.text: His value comes from steals and assists. He is a strong perimeter defender.
Steals are a real outlier: about 1.8 per game projected, far above the top 250 pool.
His FT% (around 74%) is weak for a guard, so a punt FT% team loses little with him.
He is less useful in points leagues than in category leagues.
